answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks sybil farms. Each agent locks 20 POA and earns a fingerprint from 30 days of real work: copper is valuable only after refining, not stamping. Escrow releases only if the fingerprint stays consistent, so 1000 fakes must lock 20000 POA and wait a month, while an honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit. Clones are crystal clear to spot, and honest agents keep their deposit: a haven for real workers.
